liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Deal** (2 reviews): Reviewer says Deal is exceptionally hot; Reviewer calls the Deal funky [14][16]
- **Corrina** (2 reviews): Jerry played sad, Shenandoah-like lines in Corrina, then mysteriously walked offstage; Jerry left the stage mid-Corrina, stunning the crowd; his return brought relief and smiles [13][14]
- **Satisfaction** (2 reviews): Crowd sang Satisfaction so loudly that Bobby's vocal seems quiet; he reportedly couldn't hear himself; Reviewer warns the Satisfaction encore is pretty bad [18][20]
- **Big River** (1 review): Big River after Me & My Uncle is rocking, recalling late-1970s versions [16]
- **Victim or the Crime** (1 review): House lights stayed up at the start of Victim, then dimmed soon after [13]
- **Dark Star** (1 review): When Dark Star started, the reviewer's friend went wild while the reviewer didn't know the song [22]

## Setlist highlights

- **Satisfaction**: back after 428 archived shows (2072 days) [25]

## The recordings

- **gd92-03-09.sbd.braverman.9755.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 18 songs; 137 min; rated 3.3/5 by 23 [1]. Said about its sound: Soundboard quality is described as nearly perfect; Reviewer praises the recording as great, with good sound quality; Sound quality is excellent, with no tape hiss [16][22][24]
- **gd1992-03-09.148231.nak300CP4.ebel.flac2496**: source not stated; 16 songs; 142 min [6]
- **gd1992-03-09.155828.FOBSchoepsMasterDAT.BrotmanMetchickAnonNoel.t-flac1648**: source not stated; 16 songs; 148 min [7]
- **gd1992-03-09.148232.BK4011.ebel.flac16**: source not stated; 16 songs; 140 min [12]

## Around the show

- Reviewer attended from about tenth row center, alongside a friend at his first show [19]
- Tapers were caught and busted during Iko Iko [7]
- Reviewer ranks this the best show of 1992, citing Jerry's playing off the keyboards [15]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd92-03-09.sbd.braverman.9755.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Rob Harrison; source: SBD> DAT> C> PCM> DAT> CD [1]. Also: Seeded to etree by Peter Braverman; Tony G applied a shntool fix [1]
- **gd1992-03-09.148231.nak300CP4.ebel.flac2496**: taped by Pete Ebel; transferred by Pete Ebel; source: TS Nakamichi CM-300 CP4-> Sony D5-> Sony D6-> Cassette Master (Maxell XL-II's 90's) [6]. Also: Tape flips between Row Jimmy and Cassidy and during set two were covered by a patch source [6]
- **gd1992-03-09.155828.FOBSchoepsMasterDAT.BrotmanMetchickAnonNoel.t-flac1648**: taped by Recording by Dave Brotman & Jeff Metchick; transferred by Transfer by Anonymous Edited & Mastered (Adobe Audition) by Joe Noel January 14, 2022; source: Source: (FOB) Schoeps CMC3 MK4’s (ORTF) > Tao Research > M1000 cables > Panasonic SV-255mod (16/48) > Master DAT [7]. Also: Recorded by Dave Brotman and Jeff Metchick; an anonymous person did the transfer; Pete Ebel supplied the patch source; Brotman's set-two portion was dithered to 16-bit/44.1k to match the remastered patch source [7]
- **gd1992-03-09.148232.BK4011.ebel.flac16**: transferred by Pete Ebel; source: FOB B&K 4011-> DAT [12]. Also: A Nak 300 recording filled the set-two tuning and a deck pause between Iko Iko and Corrina [12]
